records.title: RAT+: Train Dense, Infer Sparse - Recurrence Augmented Attention for Dilated Inference
records.reason: RAT+はdense pretrained attentionをinference時dilated/sparseへ切替可能にし、KV sizeとattention FLOPsを最大64分の1にする構成を評価。

records.title: Rearchitecting the Datacenter Lifecycle for AI

records.title: Sim-LLM: Optimizing LLM Inference at the Edge through Inter-Task KV Reuse
records.reason: Sim-LLMは類似タスク間でKV cacheを再利用し、edge LLM inferenceのGPU memory使用を減らしてthroughputとbatch容量を上げる。

records.title: PatternKV: Flattening KV Representation Expands Quantization Headroom
records.reason: PatternKVはKVを代表patternへ整列後residual量子化し、long-context/test-time inferenceで低bit精度とthroughputを改善。

records.title: Kaczmarz Linear Attention
records.reason: Kaczmarz Linear Attentionはonline-regression導出のstep-sizeでlinear-attention state updateを改善し、32K contextでdecode throughput向上を評価。

records.title: Investigating Recurrent Transformers with Dynamic Halt
records.reason: recurrent Transformer/dynamic haltの比較は一次要旨で確認できたが、推論system efficiencyへの具体的寄与は明確でない。研究段階で本文確認が必要。

records.title: ARC-KV: Amortizing Anchor Search for Reconstruction-Based KV Cache Compaction
records.reason: ARC-KVは再構成型KV compactionのanchor探索を学習済みindexerで償却し、compact cache品質を保ちながら作成時間を短縮。

records.title: Exploring Post-training Quantization in LLMs from Comprehensive Study to Low Rank Compensation
records.reason: AAAI primary abstract compares LLM post-training quantization schemes across model families and bit widths, then proposes low-rank compensation to recover model quality with little added size; the work directly targets LLM memory and computation cost.

records.title: Judge Q: Trainable Queries for Optimized Information Retention in KV Cache Eviction
records.reason: Judge Qはsoft query tokensでKV eviction時のglobal information importanceを推定し、同一cache budgetでLongBench/RULER品質を改善。

records.title: HqeKV: Towards Hybrid Quantization and Eviction for KV Cache in Long-Context LLM Inference
records.reason: HqeKVはKV importanceに基づくhybrid quantization/eviction最適化でlong-context LLM cache memory制約下のqualityを改善。

records.title: SPLASH: Switching Parallel Layouts of Attention with Seamless Handoff for LLM Serving
records.reason: SPLASHは実行中にattention parallel layoutを切替え、cache配置再利用・背景移送でLLM servingのKV capacityとSLO対応を改善。

records.title: Compression Barriers for Autoregressive Transformers
records.reason: 論文はautoregressive Transformer生成で可能なKV-cache compressionの理論限界と、条件付きsliding-window圧縮手法を分析。

records.title: A Survey on Memory-Efficient Fine-Tuning for Large Language Models
records.reason: 一次要旨はfine-tuning時のmemory-efficient methodsを対象とし、inference/runtime効率への直接寄与は示さない。隣接領域として本文段階の関連確認が必要。

records.title: Quasar: Quantized Self-Speculative Acceleration for Rapid Inference via Memory-Efficient Verification
records.reason: Quasarはself-speculative verification段階を低bit量子化し、memory trafficを半減しながらspeculative acceptanceとthroughputを改善。

records.title: KVCrush: Key value cache size-reduction using similarity in head-behaviour
records.reason: KVCrushはhead behavior similarityに基づくKV representation/token pruningでcache footprintを削減し、LongBench accuracyとlatencyを評価。

records.title: Temperature-Centric Investigation of Speculative Decoding with Knowledge Distillation
records.reason: 論文はsampling temperatureとknowledge distillationがspeculative decoding acceptance/speedに与える影響を調査し、高temperature時の改善方向を示す。

records.title: PatchKV: Weight-Space Compensation of KV Cache
records.reason: PatchKVはcompressed cacheで生じる誤差をcontext-specific weight patchで補い、queryごとのinference costを変えずKV圧縮を改善。

records.title: Fairy2i: Training Complex LLMs from Real LLMs with All Parameters in {± 1, ± i}
records.reason: Fairy2iは複素値4-phase低bit量子化を既存LLMへ適用し、commodity hardware上のefficient inferenceを目指して評価。

records.title: Interdomain Attention: Beyond Token-Level Key-Value Memory
records.reason: Interdomain AttentionはattentionとSSMを統合し、query-conditioned accessを固定サイズstateから行う長系列言語model architecture。

records.title: Cartridges++: KV Cache Compression without Off-Context Derailment
records.reason: Cartridges++は圧縮KVがoff-context能力を損なう問題とinference-time routing等の緩和策を扱い、長文context servingの安全なcache compressionを研究。
